_comment: Playbooks for a stack with no Confluence to read. Same fields the wiki's
Page Properties rows map onto, so what runs here is what will run there.
splunk_query holds PARAMETERS, never SPL. Storing the analyst's search
verbatim and running it would let anyone with edit access to the space run
arbitrary SPL as the service account, and SPL is not read-only.

playbooks.rule_description: The perimeter UTM engine matched a file transfer against a malware signature.
playbooks.true_condition: The file reached the endpoint, or the same host contacted the source again after the block.
playbooks.false_condition: EICAR test file, or a security-team download during a scheduled test.
playbooks.work_around: Confirm the block held, then check whether the host reached the same destination again.

playbooks.rule_description: More failed authentications from one source than the threshold allows.
playbooks.true_condition: Failures across several accounts, or a success following the failures.
playbooks.false_condition: One account, one source, right after a password change.
playbooks.work_around: Check whether any of the attempts succeeded before locking the account.
